summary: ADM Tronics filed an 8-K reporting an October 26, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement for a staged private placement of common stock at $0.10 per share, with pre-funded warrants at $0.099 and 50% accompanying warrants. Target gross proceeds are roughly $5.0 million, capped near $5.4 million. An October 27 initial closing raised $1.3 million via 13,000,000 shares plus 6.5 million warrants from three purchasers; an October 28 subsequent closing added $250,000 (2,500,000 shares plus 1.25 million warrants). Conditions included board reconstitution, D&O indemnities, insurance, a segregated account and a voting agreement. Watch dilution and further rolling closings.
